XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this pane.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%">
<hgroup valign="top" width="100%" align="left"> <!-- Create --> <vgroup valign="top" align="left" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" legend=" Resend messages (Original message / All messages) " width="100%"> <form id="srcCtrlInForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;" width="100%"> <text label="Namespace:" id="namespace" name="Namespace" size="25"/> <text label="Source Component:" id="srcComponent" name="srcComponent" size="50"/> <text label="Destination Component:" id="dstComponent" name="dstComponent" size="50"/> <spacer height="10"/> <fieldSet id="Resend" hidden="false" legend="Search Conditions " width="20%" align="left">
<radioSet id="srcCondition" name="srcCondition" displayList="Like,Equal,Not Equal" valueList="like,=,!=" value="like" align="left" /> <spacer height="10"/> <text label="Log Event Text (For Destination):" id="errStr" name="errStr" size="80"/>
<spacer height="15"/> <radioSet id="srcFields" name="srcFields" displayList="Date,SessionId" valueList="Date,Session" value="Date" align="left" onclick="zenPage.changeFields();" />
<spacer height="15"/> <fieldSet id="dtRange" hidden="false" legend="Date Range " width="100%" align="left"> <hgroup valign="top" width="100%" align="left"> <calendar label="Start Date/Time (HH24:MI:SS):" id="stDtTm1" name ="stDtTm1" showTime="true" align="center"/> <spacer width= "10"/> <calendar label="End Date/Time (HH24:MI:SS):" id="stDtTm2" name ="stDtTm2" showTime="true" align="center"/> </hgroup>
</fieldSet> <fieldSet id="sessionRange" hidden="true" legend="Session Id Range " width="20%" align="left"> <hgroup valign="top" width="30%" align="left"> <text label="Start:" id="stSessionId" name="stSessionId" size="10"/> <spacer width= "10"/> <text label="End:" id="endSessionId" name="endSessionId" size="10"/> </hgroup>
</fieldSet> </fieldSet> <spacer height="20"/> <fieldSet id="Settings" hidden="false" legend="Test/Resend " width="20%" align="left"> <spacer height="10"/> <hgroup valign="top" width="30%" align="left"> <checkbox caption="Test " value="0" id="rsndTest" title="Get IDs that will be sent" /> <spacer width="20"/> <checkbox caption="Original Only" id="rsndOrig" title="Resend original message from the source OR resent all records" /> <spacer width="20"/> <checkbox caption="Head of the Queue" id="headQ" title="Resend argument specifies whether the messages should be submitted at the head of the line or at the end of the target queue" />
<spacer width="20"/> <button id="buttonResend" align="center" caption="Resend" onclick="zenPage.resendRecs();" title="Resend records" /> </hgroup> </fieldSet> <spacer height="25"/> <label id="lblAccess" value="" /> </form> </fieldSet> </vgroup> </hgroup> </pane>
